about_the_game:
The pavilion ten miles away,

Knives and swords collide.

You will play a character named Xiao Mingming to explore!

This is a stand-alone third-person role-playing game. The fictional story takes place in the north of ancient China. The protagonist Xiao Mingming lives in an ancient city. His peaceful life is disturbed by the arrival of bandits. You will play the protagonist Xiao Mingming and face the upcoming challenges!

The protagonist of the story: Xiao Mingming, an ordinary little boy who is just, brave, and helpful.

Story environment: an ancient city in the northern plains of ancient China.

Talk to NPCs in the game and explore the story Defeat the bandits who enter the city and protect the city.

Control using mouse and keyboard.
